content.text:
**No. Sarah Chen cannot approve DR-9001 herself.** Acme is eligible for the 15% discount, but 15% is above her own approval limit. Michael Torres, VP Sales, must approve it.

1. **The request.** DR-9001 asks for 15% off NS-500 (list $250,000, discount $37,500, net $212,500). Sarah Chen raised it on 2026-09-23. It relies on a contract term: "Contract pricing per Acme Master Supply Agreement."
2. **The customer.** CRM account CRM-2048 (Acme Manufacturing, Strategic) is ERP customer C-1001 (Acme Mfg. Holdings). The DUNS number (04-812-7730) and address match. It is not Acme Industrial Supply Co. (CRM-2091 / C-1044).
3. **The product.** NS-500, the NS-500 Industrial Controller, list price $250,000.
4. **Active contract.** Master Supply Agreement ACME-MFG-2025 runs from 2025-04-01 to 2028-03-31, so it is active on 2026-09-23. Section 3.2 makes Acme eligible for up to 15% on NS-500. Section 3.3 says this does not change Northstar's internal approval authority.
5. **Pricing exception.** EXC-ACME-NS500-15 (Schedule B) covers NS-500 only, at a maximum of 15%, effective 2025-04-01 to 2028-03-31. It covers this product and date, and 15% is within the maximum. It replaced the earlier 10% exception, EXC-ACME-NS500-10, which ended 2025-03-31.
6. **Policy in force.** Northstar Pricing Policy 2026 applies (2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31). The 2027 policy does not take effect until 2027-01-01.
7. **Sarah's authority.** She is an Enterprise Account Executive, and her limit is 10% or less, so 15% exceeds it.
8. **Required approver.** The VP Sales approves discounts above 10% up to 20%. Michael Torres holds that role, and he is also Sarah's manager. The approval must be recorded in CRM.

**Why last year's approval doesn't apply.** Sarah's precedent, DR-8104 (15%, self-approved on 2025-09-16), was valid under the 2025 policy, which let account executives approve up to 15%. The 2026 policy lowered that limit to 10%, so the precedent no longer gives her authority.

```json
  "outcome": "APPROVE_WITH_AUTHORIZATION",
  "request": {"id": "DR-9001", "customer": "Acme Manufacturing (CRM-2048 / ERP C-1001 Acme Mfg. Holdings)", "product": "NS-500", "requested_discount": "15%", "date": "2026-09-23", "requestor": "Sarah Chen (Enterprise Account Executive)", "basis": "contract_exception"},
  "commercial_eligibility": {"status": "eligible", "maximum_discount": "15%", "basis": "ACME-MFG-2025 §3.2; pricing exception EXC-ACME-NS500-15 (NS-500 only, 2025-04-01 to 2028-03-31)"},
  "authority": {"policy": "PRICING-POLICY-2026", "requestor_limit": "10%", "requestor_authorized": false, "required_role": "VP Sales", "approver": "Michael Torres"},
  "evidence": ["structured/discount_requests.csv DR-9001", "structured/crm_accounts.csv CRM-2048", "structured/customers.csv C-1001", "structured/products.csv NS-500", "ACME-MFG-2025", "EXC-ACME-NS500-15", "PRICING-POLICY-2026", "APP-MATRIX-2026", "structured/employees.csv EMP-101, EMP-200", "ORG-CHART-2026-09", "SOP-SALES-014"],
  "missing_evidence": []
}
```
